gloss: to go off the scale; to swing to the limit

definitions.gloss: to swing past the maximum; to peg the meter; to go off the scale
definitions.explanation: Of a needle or gauge, to swing all the way to the end of its scale; figuratively, for a value or feeling to reach an extreme. Intransitive counterpart of {振|ふ}り{切|き}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}れ→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧た。
examples.english: The needle went off the scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音量|おんりょう}→音量：10009_onryou⟧⟦メーター→メーター：23517_meetaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}れ→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The volume meter is pegged at maximum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計器|けいき}→計器：03946_keiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}れ→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧た。
examples.english: The earthquake's shaking sent the instrument's needle off the scale.

notes:
{振|ふ}り{切|き}れる is intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Its transitive pair is ⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}る→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧ (to shake off, to swing fully).

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{振|ふ}り{切|き}れ→振り切る：06703_furikiru⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the resulting state — a needle currently pinned at the end of its scale, not an action in progress.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{針|はり}→針：03566_hari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{切|き}れる: for a needle to go off the scale
- ⟦メーター→メーター：23517_meetaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{切|き}れる: for a meter to peg out

USAGE:
Also used figuratively for emotions or energy reaching an extreme (⟦テンション→テンション：06417_tenshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{切|き}れる, to be over-the-top excited).

prominent_see_also.note: transitive pair (to shake off, to swing fully)
